main.id: insight:source — only the letter prefix of the identifier is read
main.createdAt: chart-year, chart-cum, chart-ay, kpi:last12, insight:peak, insight:pace
main.indexCity: chart-city, kpi:cities, insight:city, insight:allday_city, map:map-main — reverse-geocoded city, hyphen variants merged
main.locationName: chart-cat, insight:category, insight:allday_cat, map:map-main — venue type by keywords
main.locationOpenAllDay: chart-city, chart-cat, chart-ay, kpi:allday, insight:allday, insight:allday_city, insight:allday_cat
main.imageURL: insight:photo — only whether a photo link exists; the link is never shown
main.contactName: skip: private contact details (volunteer / owner names)
main.locationCity: skip: free-text, 15% empty; the reverse-geocoded indexCity is used instead
main.locationDescription: skip: free text, often addresses of private homes
main.locationOpenHours: skip: free text, 72% empty, multi-line fragments
main.itm-x: skip: same point as lat/lon in ITM
main.itm-y: skip: same point as lat/lon in ITM
